content:
lina: Heads-up: minimal repro where a pnpm workspace + vite preserveModules produces an edge bundle where the SDK default export becomes a namespace. Throws "TypeError: DefaultClient is not a constructor" in our edge preview.

lina: Repro steps in repo `repros/workspace-hoist-preserve-modules`:
```
pnpm i
pnpm --filter sampleapp run build
pnpm --filter sampleapp run preview:edge
```
Error only appears after `pnpm build` (production). Dev server is fine.

oscar: Paste the import and package.json for the SDK please. Wondering if conditional exports are set.

lina: Import: `import Redwood from 'redwood-inference-js'`. SDK package.json: {"main": "dist/index.cjs.js", "module": "dist/index.esm.js", "types":"dist/index.d.ts"}. We also have `preserveModules: true` in vite rollupOptions to keep per-package outputs.

oscar: That combination often leads to per-file CJS wrappers (`exports.default = ...`) being emitted. When esbuild/our edge loader transforms the bundle it wraps those into a namespace object. TS types still show default export so IDEs mislead devs.

maya: Quick workaround: change import to `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-inference-js'` and then use `const Client = (Redwood as any).default ?? Redwood; const client = new Client(opts)`. Not pretty but unblocks preview.

oscar: Longer fix options: 1) disable preserveModules for edge builds, 2) publish SDK ESM-first (remove ambiguous CJS artifact), 3) add build-time check in preview harness to scan bundles for `exports.default` and warn.

lina: I pushed the minimal repro and a short README with the workaround + a vite snippet:
```js
// vite.config.js
export default {
  build: {
    rollupOptions: { preserveModules: false },
    commonjsOptions: { transformMixedEsModules: true }
  },
  esbuild: { format: 'esm' }
}
```

build-bot: Uploaded build logs and artifact id 20260324-15.

maya: I'll add a short note to onboarding docs: run production edge preview early and check final bundle for `exports.default` occurrences. Saves many "works locally" tickets.

oscar: Filed RD-4801 to track SDK packaging changes and RD-4802 for preview-bundle diagnostics.

lina: Thanks team — putting the README link in the issue now.
